scope: Frozen provisioning/transport implementation, preparation/backend integration and static ARM64 reconstruction; not live runtime acceptance or publication authorization

findings.title: Empty selector during startup failure is mistaken for observed pipe EOF
findings.impact: First set_blocking/register failure can reap an already-exited leader and skip killpg while its descendant still holds pipes. Acquisition rejects and parent descriptors close, but local descendant work/resources leak.
findings.observed: Both first-setup failure variants left a live descendant; the registered-timeout control stopped it. The probe cleaned up all owned groups.
findings.minimal_fix: Track setup completion or actual output EOF; only take the early non-killing reap after completed setup and drained pipes. On incomplete setup kill the group before reaping. Add exited-leader/inherited-pipe failure tests.
findings.qualification: Owned-process fault-model reproduction, not a claim that normal fixed SSH flags fork helpers or that local cleanup proves remote stop.

findings.title: Reused provisioned ContextSource does not retain deployment/transport preparation checks
findings.impact: A source constructed with preparation A accepts preparation B with a different deployment or transport digest and issues a B-bound lease using A's source. The factory itself rejects the same B.
findings.minimal_fix: Retain admitted deployment/transport digests and compare them before every acquisition, or bind the original preparation digest if that is the intended API. Test source reuse with changed and unchanged preparations.
findings.qualification: The recommended acquire_provisioned_context entrypoint constructs and immediately acquires with the same preparation; that one-shot path is not shown broken. No external authorization bypass is claimed.

observed_nonblocking_limitations: Private SSH identity preflight checks only envelope delimiters and size, not decoded key or private/public pairing; deliberate non-key fixture passes PASS_PRIVATE_BUNDLE. No authentication was attempted.
untested_boundaries: Live SSH authentication, host installation/effective sshd policy, actual collector/daemon kernel placement and key provenance
